WITH unified_asset AS (
  SELECT
    *
    EXCEPT (asset_code, asset_seq_no),
    REGEXP_REPLACE(
      UPPER(
        COALESCE(
          NULLIF(TRIM(machine_number), ''),
          NULLIF(TRIM(chassis_number), ''),
          NULLIF(TRIM(vehicle_plate_no), '')
        )
      ),
      '[^A-Z0-9]+$',
      ''
    ) AS asset_id,
    asset_code AS backup_key,
    CONCAT(asset_code, '#', manufacturing_year) AS asset_code,
    COALESCE(asset_seq_no, 0) AS asset_seq_no
  FROM (
    SELECT
      created_timestamp,
      avg_market_price AS otr_price,
      agreement_number,
      TRY_CAST(asset_seq_no AS INT) AS asset_seq_no,
      1 AS source_no,
      asset_code
    FROM wsdatainnovation.cdp_asset
    WHERE
      dt = CASE WHEN '{bizdate}' < '20100101' THEN '20100101' ELSE '{bizdate}' END
  )
), unified_asset2 AS (
  SELECT
    *,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY agreement_number, asset_seq_no ORDER BY created_timestamp, source_no) AS rn
  FROM unified_asset
  WHERE
    NOT NULLIF(TRIM(asset_id), '') IS NULL AND NOT TRIM(asset_id) IN ('', '0', '-')
), unified_asset2B AS (
  SELECT
    *
    EXCEPT (rn, otr_price),
    COALESCE(
      otr_price,
      LAG(otr_price, 1) OVER (PARTITION BY asset_code ORDER BY created_timestamp)
    ) AS otr_price
  FROM unified_asset2
  WHERE
    rn = 1
), sample_size2 AS (
  SELECT
    asset_code,
    COUNT(DISTINCT asset_id) AS asset_count,
    COUNT(DISTINCT agreement_number) AS contract_count
  FROM unified_asset2B
  GROUP BY
    asset_code
), unified_asset3 AS (
  SELECT
    t1.*
    EXCEPT (asset_code, backup_key),
    (
      CASE
        WHEN (
          t2.asset_count < 30
        ) AND (
          t2.contract_count < 30
        )
        THEN backup_key
        ELSE t2.asset_code
      END
    ) AS asset_code
  FROM unified_asset2B AS t1
  LEFT JOIN sample_size2 AS t2
    ON t1.asset_code = t2.asset_code
), ranked_asset AS (
  SELECT
    asset_id,
    asset_code,
    agreement_number,
    asset_seq_no,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY asset_code ORDER BY created_timestamp, asset_seq_no) AS row_idx
  FROM unified_asset3
  WHERE
    NOT NULLIF(TRIM(asset_code), '') IS NULL AND otr_price > 0
), one_representation AS (
  SELECT
    asset_code,
    agreement_number,
    asset_seq_no
  FROM unified_asset3
), rolling_feature AS (
  SELECT
    asset_code,
    agreement_number,
    asset_seq_no
  FROM unified_asset3
  WHERE
    NOT NULLIF(TRIM(asset_code), '') IS NULL AND otr_price > 0
), ema_prep AS (
  SELECT
    asset_code,
    row_idx
  FROM ranked_asset
), LogTransform AS (
  SELECT
    asset_code,
    row_idx
  FROM ema_prep
), ema_feat_v1 AS (
  SELECT
    *
  FROM LogTransform
), ema_prep2 AS (
  SELECT
    *
  FROM ema_prep
), ema_feature AS (
  SELECT
    tA.*
  FROM ema_prep2 AS tA
  INNER JOIN ema_feat_v1 AS tB
    ON tA.asset_code = tB.asset_code AND tA.row_idx = tB.row_idx
), ewm_prep AS (
  SELECT
    asset_code,
    agreement_number,
    asset_seq_no
  FROM ranked_asset
), ewm_prep2 AS (
  SELECT
    *
  FROM ewm_prep
), ewm_feature AS (
  SELECT
    *
  FROM ewm_prep2
), final_joined_view AS (
  SELECT
    t0.*
    EXCEPT (event_timestamp),
    t1.*
    EXCEPT (asset_code, agreement_number, asset_seq_no, description_nunique, manufacturing_nunique, created_timestamp, manufacturing_year, next_production),
    t2.*
    EXCEPT (asset_code, agreement_number, asset_seq_no)
  FROM ranked_asset AS t0
  LEFT JOIN one_representation AS t1
    ON t0.asset_code = t1.asset_code
    AND t0.agreement_number = t1.agreement_number
    AND t0.asset_seq_no = t1.asset_seq_no
  LEFT JOIN rolling_feature AS t2
    ON t0.asset_code = t2.asset_code
    AND t0.agreement_number = t2.agreement_number
    AND t0.asset_seq_no = t2.asset_seq_no
  LEFT JOIN ema_feature AS t3
    ON t0.asset_code = t3.asset_code AND t0.row_idx = t3.row_idx
  LEFT JOIN ewm_feature AS t4
    ON t0.asset_code = t4.asset_code
    AND t0.agreement_number = t4.agreement_number
    AND t0.asset_seq_no = t4.asset_seq_no
  LEFT JOIN (
    SELECT
    FROM unified_asset3
    GROUP BY
      asset_code
  ) AS t5
    ON t0.asset_code = t5.asset_code
)
SELECT
  *
FROM final_joined_view

WITH one_source_agreement AS (
  SELECT
    dt,
    agreement_number
  FROM wsdatainnovation.cdp_identity_resolution
  WHERE
    dt = CASE WHEN '{bizdate}' < '20100101' THEN '20100101' ELSE '{bizdate}' END
    AND NOT NULLIF(TRIM(agreement_number), '') IS NULL
  GROUP BY
    dt,
    agreement_number
), asset_prep1 AS (
  SELECT
    t1.agreement_number,
    t2.*
    EXCEPT (dt, agreement_number),
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY t1.agreement_number ORDER BY created_timestamp DESC) AS rn
  FROM one_source_agreement AS t1
  INNER JOIN wsDataInnovation.cdp_asset AS t2
    ON t1.dt = t2.dt AND t1.agreement_number = t2.agreement_number
), asset_prep2 AS (
  SELECT
    agreement_number,
    TIME_TO_STR(TRY_CAST(created_timestamp AS DATETIME), '%Y%m%d') AS ts_id,
    created_timestamp AS event_timestamp
  FROM asset_prep1
  UNION
  SELECT
    agreement_number,
    '{bizdate}' AS ts_id,
    TRY_CAST(STR_TO_TIME('{bizdate}', 'yyyymmdd') AS TIMESTAMP) AS event_timestamp
  FROM asset_prep1 AS t2
  WHERE
    t2.rn = 1
    AND TRY_CAST(t2.created_timestamp AS DATETIME) < TRY_CAST(STR_TO_TIME('{bizdate}', 'yyyymmdd') AS DATETIME)
), contract_asset_feat AS (
  SELECT
    agreement_number, /* ,ts_id -- for join multiple views */
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY agreement_number, ts_id ORDER BY event_timestamp DESC) AS rn
  FROM asset_prep2
)
SELECT
  agreement_number /* forward_fill */
FROM contract_asset_feat
WHERE
  rn = 1

WITH loan_snapshot AS (
  SELECT
    TRIM(agreement_number) AS agreement_number,
    created_timestamp AS loan_created_timestamp
  FROM wsDataInnovation.cdp_loan
  WHERE
    dt = '{bizdate}'
    AND NOT agreement_number IS NULL
    AND CAST(created_timestamp AS TEXT) <> '1900'
), loan_ts_grid AS (
  SELECT
    agreement_number,
    CAST(loan_created_timestamp AS TEXT) AS ts_id
  FROM loan_snapshot
  WHERE
    NOT loan_created_timestamp IS NULL
), collection_scan AS (
  SELECT
    TRIM(agreement_number) AS agreement_number,
    dt AS ts_id
  FROM wsDataInnovation.cdp_collection
  WHERE
    dt <= '{bizdate}' AND NOT agreement_number IS NULL
), loan_scan AS (
  SELECT
    TRIM(agreement_number) AS agreement_number,
    dt AS ts_id
  FROM wsDataInnovation.cdp_loan
  WHERE
    dt <= '{bizdate}' AND NOT agreement_number IS NULL
), collection_ts_grid AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT
    agreement_number,
    ts_id
  FROM collection_scan
  UNION
  SELECT DISTINCT
    agreement_number,
    ts_id
  FROM loan_scan
), combined_ts_grid AS (
  SELECT
    agreement_number,
    ts_id
  FROM loan_ts_grid
  UNION
  SELECT
    agreement_number,
    ts_id
  FROM collection_ts_grid
  UNION
  SELECT
    agreement_number,
    '{bizdate}' AS ts_id
  FROM loan_snapshot
), collection_agg AS (
  SELECT
    agreement_number,
    ts_id
  FROM collection_scan
  GROUP BY
    agreement_number,
    ts_id
), loan_agg AS (
  SELECT
    agreement_number,
    ts_id
  FROM loan_scan
  GROUP BY
    agreement_number,
    ts_id
), joined AS (
  SELECT
    g.agreement_number
  FROM (
    SELECT DISTINCT
      agreement_number
    FROM combined_ts_grid
  ) AS g
  LEFT JOIN collection_agg AS ca
    ON g.agreement_number = ca.agreement_number AND g.ts_id = ca.ts_id
  LEFT JOIN loan_agg AS la
    ON g.agreement_number = la.agreement_number AND g.ts_id = la.ts_id
), forward_filled AS (
  SELECT
    agreement_number
  FROM joined
)
SELECT
  agreement_number
FROM forward_filled

WITH lookup_window_init AS (
  SELECT
    NULLIF(TRIM(confins_application_id), '') AS applicationid,
    NULLIF(TRIM(lon.agreement_number), '') AS agreementno,
    NULLIF(TRIM(confins_customer_id), '') AS customerid,
    lon.dt,
    UPPER(TRIM(product)) AS productname,
    UPPER(TRIM(asset_type_id)) AS productgroup,
    GREATEST(golive_at, TRY_CAST(lon.application_date AS DATETIME)) AS event_timestamp,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
      PARTITION BY COALESCE(application_id, lon.agreement_number), confins_customer_id, product, asset_type_id
      ORDER BY lon.application_date DESC
    ) AS rn
  FROM wsDataInnovation.cdp_loan AS lon
  LEFT JOIN wsDataInnovation.cdp_asset AS ast
    ON lon.agreement_number = ast.agreement_number AND lon.dt = ast.dt
  WHERE
    lon.dt = '{bizdate}' AND NOT lon.contract_status IN ('CAN', 'PRP', 'RJC')
), RO_DF_prep1 AS (
  SELECT
    *
    EXCEPT (rn),
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY customerid ORDER BY event_timestamp) AS rn /* re-occurence index */
  FROM lookup_window_init
  WHERE
    customerid IN (
      SELECT
        customerid
      FROM lookup_window_init
      WHERE
        productname = 'DF'
        AND productgroup = 'MOBIL'
        AND (
          TRY_CAST(event_timestamp AS DATETIME) BETWEEN STR_TO_TIME('20210101', 'yyyymmdd') AND STR_TO_TIME('{bizdate}', 'yyyymmdd')
        )
    )
    AND rn = 1
), RO_DF_prep2 AS (
  SELECT
    *,
    LAG(COALESCE(applicationid, agreementno), 1) OVER (PARTITION BY customerid ORDER BY event_timestamp) AS prev_contract,
    LEAD(COALESCE(applicationid, agreementno), 1) OVER (PARTITION BY customerid ORDER BY event_timestamp) AS next_contract,
    COALESCE(
      TS_OR_DS_ADD(
        LEAD(event_timestamp, 1) OVER (PARTITION BY customerid ORDER BY event_timestamp),
        -1,
        DD
      ),
      STR_TO_TIME('{bizdate}', 'yyyymmdd')
    ) AS upper_time_limit
  FROM RO_DF_prep1
), RO_DF_feat3 AS (
  SELECT
    rdp.*,
    col.created_timestamp AS collection_created,
    col.updated_timestamp AS collection_updated, /* customer demography */
    LEAST(led.lead_created_at, led.created_timestamp) AS lead_created,
    led.updated_timestamp AS lead_updated, /* fee */
    TRY_CAST(lon.created_timestamp AS DATETIME) AS loan_inserted, /* loan outstanding */
    pay.created_timestamp AS payment_created,
    pay.updated_timestamp AS payment_updated, /* asset */
    ast.created_timestamp AS asset_registered,
    pef.created_timestamp AS pefindo_created,
    pef.updated_timestamp AS pefindo_updated
  FROM RO_DF_prep2 AS rdp
  LEFT JOIN wsdatainnovation.cdp_loan AS lon
    ON lon.agreement_number = rdp.agreementno
    AND lon.dt = rdp.dt
    AND TRY_CAST(lon.created_timestamp AS DATETIME) < rdp.upper_time_limit
  LEFT JOIN wsbfi_2.dwh_vw_dim_region_odps AS vdr
    ON TRIM(lon.branch_id) = TRIM(vdr.id_branch)
    AND TRY_CAST(rdp.event_timestamp AS DATETIME) BETWEEN vdr.effective_date AND COALESCE(vdr.expiration_date, STR_TO_TIME('{bizdate}', 'yyyymmdd'))
  LEFT JOIN wsDataInnovation.cdp_asset AS ast
    ON ast.agreement_number = rdp.agreementno
    AND ast.dt = rdp.dt
    AND TRY_CAST(ast.created_timestamp AS DATETIME) < rdp.upper_time_limit
  LEFT JOIN wsDataInnovation.cdp_lead AS led
    ON led.confins_customer_id = rdp.customerid
    AND led.dt = rdp.dt
    AND GREATEST(led.updated_timestamp, led.created_timestamp) < TRY_CAST(rdp.upper_time_limit AS TIMESTAMP)
  LEFT JOIN wsDataInnovation.cdp_collection AS col
    ON col.agreement_number = rdp.agreementno
    AND col.dt = rdp.dt
    AND GREATEST(col.updated_timestamp, col.created_timestamp) < TRY_CAST(rdp.upper_time_limit AS TIMESTAMP)
  LEFT JOIN wsDataInnovation.cdp_score AS pef
    ON pef.application_id = rdp.applicationid
    AND pef.dt = rdp.dt
    AND GREATEST(pef.updated_timestamp, pef.created_timestamp) < TRY_CAST(rdp.upper_time_limit AS TIMESTAMP)
  LEFT JOIN wsDataInnovation.cdp_payment_summary AS pay
    ON pay.confins_customer_id = rdp.customerid
    AND pay.dt = rdp.dt
    AND GREATEST(pay.updated_timestamp, pay.created_timestamp) < TRY_CAST(rdp.upper_time_limit AS TIMESTAMP)
  LEFT JOIN wsbfi_2.confins_stg_agreement_odps AS csa
    ON TRIM(csa.applicationid) = rdp.applicationid
  LEFT JOIN wsDataInnovation.cdp_identity_resolution AS idr
    ON TRIM(idr.agreement_number) = rdp.agreementno AND idr.dt = rdp.dt
  LEFT JOIN wsbfi_2.dwh_dim_supplier_odps AS sup
    ON TRIM(csa.supplierid) = TRIM(sup.id_supplier)
    AND TRY_CAST(rdp.event_timestamp AS DATETIME) BETWEEN sup.effective_date AND COALESCE(sup.expiration_date, STR_TO_TIME('{bizdate}', 'yyyymmdd'))
), RO_DF_final AS (
  SELECT
    *
    EXCEPT (rn),
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
      PARTITION BY customerid, COALESCE(applicationid, agreementno), productname, productgroup, rn, prev_contract, next_contract
      ORDER BY GREATEST(
        TRY_CAST(loan_inserted AS TIMESTAMP),
        asset_registered,
        COALESCE(lead_updated, lead_created),
        COALESCE(payment_updated, payment_created),
        COALESCE(pefindo_updated, pefindo_created),
        COALESCE(collection_updated, collection_created)
      )
    ) AS rn
  FROM RO_DF_feat3

WITH lookup_window_init AS (
  SELECT
    NULLIF(TRIM(confins_application_id), '') AS applicationid,
    NULLIF(TRIM(lon.agreement_number), '') AS agreementno,
    NULLIF(TRIM(confins_customer_id), '') AS customerid,
    lon.dt,
    UPPER(TRIM(product)) AS productname,
    UPPER(TRIM(asset_type_id)) AS productgroup,
    GREATEST(golive_at, TRY_CAST(lon.application_date AS DATETIME)) AS event_timestamp,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
      PARTITION BY COALESCE(application_id, lon.agreement_number), confins_customer_id, product, asset_type_id
      ORDER BY lon.application_date DESC
    ) AS rn
  FROM wsDataInnovation.cdp_loan AS lon
  LEFT JOIN wsDataInnovation.cdp_asset AS ast
    ON lon.agreement_number = ast.agreement_number AND lon.dt = ast.dt
  WHERE
    lon.dt = '{bizdate}' AND NOT lon.contract_status IN ('CAN', 'PRP', 'RJC')
), RO_DF_prep1 AS (
  SELECT
    *
    EXCEPT (rn),
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY customerid ORDER BY event_timestamp) AS rn /* re-occurence index */
  FROM lookup_window_init
  WHERE
    customerid IN (
      SELECT
        customerid
      FROM lookup_window_init
      WHERE
        productname = 'DF'
        AND productgroup = 'MOBIL'
        AND (
          TRY_CAST(event_timestamp AS DATETIME) BETWEEN STR_TO_TIME('20210101', 'yyyymmdd') AND STR_TO_TIME('{bizdate}', 'yyyymmdd')
        )
    )
    AND rn = 1
), RO_DF_prep2 AS (
  SELECT
    *,
    LAG(COALESCE(applicationid, agreementno), 1) OVER (PARTITION BY customerid ORDER BY event_timestamp) AS prev_contract,
    LEAD(COALESCE(applicationid, agreementno), 1) OVER (PARTITION BY customerid ORDER BY event_timestamp) AS next_contract,
    COALESCE(
      TS_OR_DS_ADD(
        LEAD(event_timestamp, 1) OVER (PARTITION BY customerid ORDER BY event_timestamp),
        -1,
        DD
      ),
      STR_TO_TIME('{bizdate}', 'yyyymmdd')
    ) AS upper_time_limit
  FROM RO_DF_prep1
), RO_DF_feat3 AS (
  SELECT
    rdp.*,
    col.created_timestamp AS collection_created,
    col.updated_timestamp AS collection_updated, /* customer demography */
    LEAST(led.lead_created_at, led.created_timestamp) AS lead_created,
    led.updated_timestamp AS lead_updated, /* fee */
    TRY_CAST(lon.created_timestamp AS DATETIME) AS loan_inserted, /* loan outstanding */
    pay.created_timestamp AS payment_created,
    pay.updated_timestamp AS payment_updated, /* asset */
    ast.created_timestamp AS asset_registered,
    ast.manufacturing_year,
    pef.created_timestamp AS pefindo_created,
    pef.updated_timestamp AS pefindo_updated
  FROM RO_DF_prep2 AS rdp
  LEFT JOIN wsdatainnovation.cdp_loan AS lon
    ON lon.agreement_number = rdp.agreementno
    AND lon.dt = rdp.dt
    AND TRY_CAST(lon.created_timestamp AS DATETIME) < rdp.upper_time_limit
  LEFT JOIN wsbfi_2.dwh_vw_dim_region_odps AS vdr
    ON TRIM(lon.branch_id) = TRIM(vdr.id_branch)
    AND TRY_CAST(rdp.event_timestamp AS DATETIME) BETWEEN vdr.effective_date AND COALESCE(vdr.expiration_date, STR_TO_TIME('{bizdate}', 'yyyymmdd'))
  LEFT JOIN wsDataInnovation.cdp_asset AS ast
    ON ast.agreement_number = rdp.agreementno
    AND ast.dt = rdp.dt
    AND TRY_CAST(ast.created_timestamp AS DATETIME) < rdp.upper_time_limit
  LEFT JOIN wsDataInnovation.cdp_lead AS led
    ON led.confins_customer_id = rdp.customerid
    AND led.dt = rdp.dt
    AND GREATEST(led.updated_timestamp, led.created_timestamp) < TRY_CAST(rdp.upper_time_limit AS TIMESTAMP)
  LEFT JOIN wsDataInnovation.cdp_collection AS col
    ON col.agreement_number = rdp.agreementno
    AND col.dt = rdp.dt
    AND GREATEST(col.updated_timestamp, col.created_timestamp) < TRY_CAST(rdp.upper_time_limit AS TIMESTAMP)
  LEFT JOIN wsDataInnovation.cdp_score AS pef
    ON pef.application_id = rdp.applicationid
    AND pef.dt = rdp.dt
    AND GREATEST(pef.updated_timestamp, pef.created_timestamp) < TRY_CAST(rdp.upper_time_limit AS TIMESTAMP)
  LEFT JOIN wsDataInnovation.cdp_payment_summary AS pay
    ON pay.confins_customer_id = rdp.customerid
    AND pay.dt = rdp.dt
    AND GREATEST(pay.updated_timestamp, pay.created_timestamp) < TRY_CAST(rdp.upper_time_limit AS TIMESTAMP)
  LEFT JOIN wsbfi_2.confins_stg_agreement_odps AS csa
    ON TRIM(csa.applicationid) = rdp.applicationid
  LEFT JOIN wsDataInnovation.cdp_identity_resolution AS idr
    ON TRIM(idr.agreement_number) = rdp.agreementno AND idr.dt = rdp.dt
  LEFT JOIN wsbfi_2.dwh_dim_supplier_odps AS sup
    ON TRIM(csa.supplierid) = TRIM(sup.id_supplier)
    AND TRY_CAST(rdp.event_timestamp AS DATETIME) BETWEEN sup.effective_date AND COALESCE(sup.expiration_date, STR_TO_TIME('{bizdate}', 'yyyymmdd'))
), RO_DF_final AS (
  SELECT
    *
    EXCEPT (rn),
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
      PARTITION BY customerid, COALESCE(applicationid, agreementno), productname, productgroup, rn, prev_contract, next_contract
      ORDER BY GREATEST(
        TRY_CAST(loan_inserted AS TIMESTAMP),
        asset_registered,
        COALESCE(lead_updated, lead_created),
        COALESCE(payment_updated, payment_created),

    EXCEPT (asset_code, agreement_number, asset_seq_no),
    t5.contract_count
  FROM ranked_asset AS t0
  LEFT JOIN one_representation AS t1
    ON t0.asset_code = t1.asset_code
    AND t0.agreement_number = t1.agreement_number
    AND t0.asset_seq_no = t1.asset_seq_no
  LEFT JOIN rolling_feature AS t2
    ON t0.asset_code = t2.asset_code
    AND t0.agreement_number = t2.agreement_number
    AND t0.asset_seq_no = t2.asset_seq_no
  LEFT JOIN ema_feature AS t3
    ON t0.asset_code = t3.asset_code AND t0.row_idx = t3.row_idx
  LEFT JOIN ewm_feature AS t4
    ON t0.asset_code = t4.asset_code
    AND t0.agreement_number = t4.agreement_number
    AND t0.asset_seq_no = t4.asset_seq_no
  LEFT JOIN (
    SELECT
      COUNT(DISTINCT agreement_number) AS contract_count
    FROM unified_asset3
    GROUP BY
      asset_code
  ) AS t5
    ON t0.asset_code = t5.asset_code
)
SELECT
  *
FROM final_joined_view

WITH final_joined_view AS (
  SELECT
    t0.*
    EXCEPT (event_timestamp), /* t0.asset_id */ /* ,t0.asset_code */ /* ,t0.agreement_number */ /* ,t0.asset_seq_no */ /* ,t0.otr_price */ /* ,t0.row_idx */ /* ,t0.lag_month */
    t1.*
    EXCEPT (asset_code, agreement_number, asset_seq_no, description_nunique, manufacturing_nunique, created_timestamp, manufacturing_year, next_production), /* ,t1.asset_type */ /* ,t1.bpkb_ownership */ /* ,t1.bpkb_status */ /* ,t1.brand */ /* ,t1.stnk_status */ /* ,t1.tax_status */ /* ,t1.vehicle_category */ /* ,t1.vehicle_category_nunique */
    t2.*
    EXCEPT (asset_code, agreement_number, asset_seq_no),
    t0.event_timestamp
  FROM ranked_asset AS t0
  LEFT JOIN one_representation AS t1
    ON t0.asset_code = t1.asset_code
    AND t0.agreement_number = t1.agreement_number
    AND t0.asset_seq_no = t1.asset_seq_no /* 1m 17s */
  LEFT JOIN rolling_feature AS t2
    ON t0.asset_code = t2.asset_code
    AND t0.agreement_number = t2.agreement_number
    AND t0.asset_seq_no = t2.asset_seq_no /* 1m 24s */
  LEFT JOIN ema_feature AS t3
    ON t0.asset_code = t3.asset_code AND t0.row_idx = t3.row_idx /* 1m 42s */
  LEFT JOIN ewm_feature AS t4
    ON t0.asset_code = t4.asset_code
    AND t0.agreement_number = t4.agreement_number
    AND t0.asset_seq_no = t4.asset_seq_no /* 1m 39s */
  LEFT JOIN (
    SELECT
    FROM unified_asset3
    GROUP BY
      asset_code
  ) AS t5
    ON t0.asset_code = t5.asset_code
), ranked_asset AS (
  SELECT
    asset_code,
    agreement_number,
    asset_seq_no,
    created_timestamp AS event_timestamp,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY asset_code ORDER BY created_timestamp, asset_seq_no) AS row_idx /* ,DATEDIFF(CAST(TO_DATE('20260626','yyyymmdd') AS DATETIME),CAST(created_timestamp AS DATETIME),'mm') AS lag_month */
  FROM unified_asset3
  WHERE
    NOT NULLIF(TRIM(asset_code), '') IS NULL AND otr_price > 0
), unified_asset3 AS (
  SELECT
    t1.*
    EXCEPT (asset_code, backup_key), /* if sample size too small then revert to asset code only without manufacturing year */
    (
      CASE
        WHEN (
          t2.asset_count < 30
        ) AND (
          t2.contract_count < 30
        )
        THEN backup_key
        ELSE t2.asset_code
      END
    ) AS asset_code
  FROM unified_asset2B AS t1
  LEFT JOIN sample_size2 AS t2
    ON t1.asset_code = t2.asset_code
), unified_asset2B AS (
  SELECT
    *
    EXCEPT (rn, otr_price), /* forward fill */
    COALESCE(
      otr_price,
      LAG(otr_price, 1) OVER (PARTITION BY asset_code ORDER BY created_timestamp)
    ) AS otr_price
  FROM unified_asset2
  WHERE
    rn = 1
), unified_asset2 AS (
  SELECT
    *,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY agreement_number, asset_seq_no ORDER BY created_timestamp, source_no) AS rn
  FROM unified_asset
  WHERE
    NOT NULLIF(TRIM(asset_id), '') IS NULL AND NOT TRIM(asset_id) IN ('', '0', '-')
), unified_asset AS (
  SELECT
    *
    EXCEPT (asset_code, asset_seq_no),
    REGEXP_REPLACE(
      UPPER(
        COALESCE(
          NULLIF(TRIM(machine_number), ''),
          NULLIF(TRIM(chassis_number), ''),
          NULLIF(TRIM(vehicle_plate_no), '')
        )
      ),
      '[^A-Z0-9]+$',
      ''
    ) AS asset_id,
    asset_code AS backup_key,
    CONCAT(asset_code, '#', manufacturing_year) AS asset_code,
    COALESCE(asset_seq_no, 0) AS asset_seq_no
  FROM (
    SELECT
      created_timestamp,
      avg_market_price AS otr_price,
      agreement_number,
      TRY_CAST(asset_seq_no AS INT) AS asset_seq_no,
      1 AS source_no,
      asset_code
    FROM wsdatainnovation.cdp_asset
    WHERE
      dt = CASE WHEN '{bizdate}' < '20100101' THEN '20100101' ELSE '{bizdate}' END
  )
), sample_size2 AS (
  SELECT
    asset_code,
    COUNT(DISTINCT asset_id) AS asset_count,
    COUNT(DISTINCT agreement_number) AS contract_count
  FROM unified_asset2B
  GROUP BY
    asset_code
), one_representation AS (
  SELECT
    asset_code,
    agreement_number,
    asset_seq_no
  FROM unified_asset3
), rolling_feature AS (
  SELECT
    asset_code,
    agreement_number,
    asset_seq_no /* asset_id -- replaced by asset_code */ /* 1. MEAN (AVG) translation over 90 Days and 6 Months lookback */
  FROM unified_asset3
  WHERE
    NOT NULLIF(TRIM(asset_code), '') IS NULL AND otr_price > 0
), ema_feature AS (
  SELECT
    tA.* /* ,ROUND(SUM((otr_price * alpha_v1_m3) / POWER(1.0 - alpha_v1_m3,row_idx)) OVER ( */ /*     PARTITION BY asset_code ORDER BY event_timestamp ROWS UNBOUNDED PRECEDING */ /* ) * POWER(1.0 - alpha_v1_m3,row_idx),2) AS otr_ema_v1_m3 -- exact trick */
  FROM ema_prep2 AS tA
  INNER JOIN ema_feat_v1 AS tB
    ON tA.asset_code = tB.asset_code AND tA.row_idx = tB.row_idx
), ema_prep2 AS (
  SELECT
    *
  FROM ema_prep
), ema_prep AS (
  SELECT
    asset_code, /* asset_id -- replaced by asset_code */
    row_idx /* Define constant alpha for a 90-period span: 2 / (90 + 1) = 0.021978 */
  FROM ranked_asset
), ema_feat_v1 AS (
  SELECT
    *
  FROM LogTransform
), LogTransform AS (
  SELECT
    asset_code,
    row_idx
  FROM ema_prep
), ewm_feature AS (
  SELECT
    *
  FROM ewm_prep2
), ewm_prep2 AS (
  SELECT
    *
  FROM ewm_prep
), ewm_prep AS (
  SELECT
    asset_code,
    agreement_number,
    asset_seq_no
  FROM ranked_asset
)
SELECT
  *
FROM final_joined_view

WITH unified_customer AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT
    tb1.cdp_uid,
    NULLIF(TRIM(tb1.agreement_number), '') AS agreement_number,
    tb1.dt,
    LEAST(
      COALESCE(tb2.created_timestamp, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP()),
      COALESCE(tb3.created_timestamp, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP()),
      COALESCE(tb4.created_timestamp, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP())
    ) AS event_ts
  FROM wsDataInnovation.cdp_identity_resolution AS tb1
  LEFT JOIN wsDataInnovation.cdp_lead AS tb2
    ON tb1.lead_id = tb2.lead_id AND tb1.dt = tb2.dt
  LEFT JOIN wsDataInnovation.cdp_loan AS tb3
    ON TRIM(tb1.agreement_number) = TRIM(tb3.agreement_number) AND tb1.dt = tb3.dt
  LEFT JOIN wsDataInnovation.cdp_collection AS tb4
    ON TRIM(tb1.agreement_number) = TRIM(tb4.agreement_number) AND tb1.dt = tb4.dt
  WHERE
    tb1.dt = CASE WHEN '{bizdate}' < '20100101' THEN '20100101' ELSE '{bizdate}' END
    AND /* WHERE tb1.dt = '20260621' */ NOT NULLIF(TRIM(tb1.agreement_number), '') IS NULL
), window_feature1 AS (
  SELECT
    cdp_uid,
    uc.agreement_number,
    COALESCE(co.updated_timestamp, co.created_timestamp) AS event_ts /* last updated timestamp of collection record */
  FROM unified_customer AS uc
  INNER JOIN wsDataInnovation.cdp_collection AS co
    ON uc.dt = co.dt AND uc.agreement_number = TRIM(co.agreement_number)
  WHERE
    co.dt = '{bizdate}' /* '20260621' -- */
    AND NOT NULLIF(TRIM(co.agreement_number), '') IS NULL
), collection_view AS (
  SELECT
    uc.cdp_uid,
    MAX(
      GREATEST(uc.event_ts, cl.created_timestamp, TRY_CAST(cl.application_date AS TIMESTAMP))
    ) AS event_timestamp /* ,CAST(TO_DATE(uc.dt,'yyyymmdd') AS TIMESTAMP) */
  FROM unified_customer AS uc
  INNER JOIN wsDataInnovation.cdp_loan AS cl
    ON cl.dt = uc.dt AND uc.agreement_number = TRIM(cl.agreement_number)
  INNER JOIN wsDataInnovation.cdp_collection AS co
    ON co.dt = uc.dt AND uc.agreement_number = TRIM(co.agreement_number)
  INNER JOIN window_feature1 AS wf1
    ON wf1.agreement_number = uc.agreement_number AND wf1.cdp_uid = uc.cdp_uid
  GROUP BY
    uc.cdp_uid
), feature_subset1 AS (
  SELECT
    *
    EXCEPT (bucket_code, default_code)
  FROM collection_view
), window_feature2 AS (
  SELECT
    cdp_uid,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY cdp_uid ORDER BY event_ts DESC) AS rn
  FROM window_feature1
)
SELECT
  fs1.*,
  tb2.*
  EXCEPT (cdp_uid, rn)
FROM feature_subset1 AS fs1
LEFT JOIN (
  SELECT
    *
  FROM window_feature2
  WHERE
    rn = 1
) AS tb2
  ON fs1.cdp_uid = tb2.cdp_uid /* WHERE   max_dpd_l1m IS NOT NULL */ /* OR      max_dpd_l3m IS NOT NULL */ /* OR      latest_collection_effectiveness IS NOT NULL */ /* OR      latest_persona IS NOT NULL */

WITH parent_agreement_cte AS (
  SELECT
    sv.cdp_uid,
    sv.ts_id,
    GREATEST(sv.event_timestamp, ca.created_timestamp) AS event_timestamp,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
      PARTITION BY sv.cdp_uid, sv.ts_id
      ORDER BY TRY_CAST(ca.manufacturing_year AS INT) DESC, TRY_CAST(cl.golive_at AS DATETIME) DESC
    ) AS rn
  FROM feature_subset_v2 AS sv
  INNER JOIN cdp_identity_resolution AS ci
    ON sv.cdp_uid = ci.cdp_uid /* exist on both main tables */
  LEFT JOIN wsDataInnovation.cdp_loan AS cl
    ON cl.dt = ci.dt AND cl.agreement_number = ci.agreement_number
  LEFT JOIN wsDataInnovation.cdp_asset AS ca
    ON ca.dt = ci.dt AND ca.agreement_number = ci.agreement_number
  LEFT JOIN wsDataInnovation.cdp_branch AS cb
    ON cb.dt = cl.dt AND cb.branch_id = cl.branch_id
  WHERE
    TRY_CAST(TIME_TO_STR(TRY_CAST(ca.created_timestamp AS DATETIME), '%Y%m%d') AS INT) <= sv.ts_id
), feature_subset_v2 AS (
  SELECT
    *
  FROM subset_view1
), subset_view1 AS (
  SELECT
    t1.cdp_uid,
    t1.ts_id,
    t2.*
    EXCEPT (cdp_uid, ts_id, created_timestamp, rn),
    t6.*
    EXCEPT (cdp_uid, ts_id, created_timestamp, rn),
    t7.*
    EXCEPT (cdp_uid, ts_id, created_timestamp, rn), /* ,GREATEST(t2.created_timestamp,t3.created_timestamp,t4.created_timestamp,t5.created_timestamp,t6.created_timestamp,t7.created_timestamp) AS event_ts */
    t1.event_timestamp
  FROM (
    SELECT
      cdp_uid,
      ts_id,
      MAX(created_timestamp) AS event_timestamp
    FROM cdp_combination_v2
    GROUP BY
      cdp_uid,
      ts_id
  ) AS t1
  LEFT JOIN tb2_first_last AS t2
    ON t2.cdp_uid = t1.cdp_uid AND t2.ts_id = t1.ts_id AND t2.rn = 1
  LEFT JOIN ranked_product_per_row AS t3
    ON t3.cdp_uid = t1.cdp_uid AND t3.ts_id = t1.ts_id AND t3.rn = 1
  LEFT JOIN ranked_tenor_per_row AS t4
    ON t4.cdp_uid = t1.cdp_uid AND t4.ts_id = t1.ts_id AND t4.rn = 1
  LEFT JOIN ranked_way_financing_per_row AS t5
    ON t5.cdp_uid = t1.cdp_uid AND t5.ts_id = t1.ts_id AND t5.rn = 1
  LEFT JOIN tb6_nunique AS t6
    ON t6.cdp_uid = t1.cdp_uid AND t6.ts_id = t1.ts_id AND t6.rn = 1
  LEFT JOIN tb7_aggregation_v2 AS t7
    ON t7.cdp_uid = t1.cdp_uid AND t7.ts_id = t1.ts_id AND t7.rn = 1
), tb2_first_last AS (
  SELECT
    *, /* pick last copy of each entity snapshot */
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY cdp_uid, ts_id ORDER BY created_timestamp DESC) AS rn
  FROM feature_windowing_first_last
  UNION ALL
  SELECT
    cdp_uid,
    TRY_CAST('{bizdate}' AS INT) AS ts_id,
    *
    EXCEPT (cdp_uid, ts_id, created_timestamp, rn_i), /* ordering columns */
    TRY_CAST(STR_TO_TIME('{bizdate}', 'yyyymmdd') AS TIMESTAMP) AS created_timestamp,
    rn_i AS rn
  FROM (
    SELECT
      *
    FROM feature_windowing_first_last
  ) AS t2
  WHERE
    t2.rn_i = 1
    AND ts_id < TRY_CAST('{bizdate}' AS INT) /* only refresh the old one       */
), feature_windowing_first_last AS (
  SELECT
    t1.cdp_uid,
    TRY_CAST(TIME_TO_STR(TRY_CAST(t2.created_timestamp AS DATETIME), '%Y%m%d') AS INT) AS ts_id,
    created_timestamp
  FROM cdp_identity_resolution AS t1
  INNER JOIN wsdatainnovation.cdp_loan AS t2
    ON t1.agreement_number = t2.agreement_number
    AND t1.dt = t2.dt /* 'CANCEL', 'PENDING', 'REJECT' status are not considered as they do not represent actual contract */
  WHERE
    NOT contract_status IN ('CAN', 'PRP', 'RJC')
), cdp_identity_resolution AS (
  SELECT
    dt,
    cdp_uid,
    lead_id,
    application_id,
    NULLIF(TRIM(agreement_number), '') AS agreement_number
  FROM wsdatainnovation.cdp_identity_resolution
  WHERE
    dt = CASE WHEN '{bizdate}' < '20100101' THEN '20100101' ELSE '{bizdate}' END /* in order to get distinct rows of cdp_uid, lead_id, application_id, agreement_number */
  GROUP BY
    dt,
    cdp_uid,
    lead_id,
    application_id,
    agreement_number
), cdp_combination_v2 AS (
  SELECT
    cdp_uid,
    ts_id,
    created_timestamp
  FROM tb2_first_last
  UNION ALL
  SELECT
    cdp_uid,
    ts_id,
    created_timestamp
  FROM tb7_aggregation_v2
), tb7_aggregation_v2 AS (
  SELECT
    *,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY cdp_uid, ts_id ORDER BY created_timestamp DESC) AS rn
  FROM feature_windowing_aggregation_v2
  UNION ALL
  SELECT
    *
    EXCEPT (created_timestamp, ts_id, rn_i),
    TRY_CAST(STR_TO_TIME('{bizdate}', 'yyyymmdd') AS TIMESTAMP) AS created_timestamp,
    TRY_CAST('{bizdate}' AS INT) AS ts_id,
    rn_i AS rn
  FROM (
    SELECT
      *
    FROM feature_windowing_aggregation_v2
  ) AS t2
  WHERE
    t2.rn_i = 1
    AND t2.ts_id < TRY_CAST('{bizdate}' AS INT) /* only refresh the old one */
), feature_windowing_aggregation_v2 AS (
  SELECT
    *,
    TRY_CAST(TIME_TO_STR(TRY_CAST(created_timestamp AS DATETIME), '%Y%m%d') AS INT) AS ts_id
  FROM feature_windowing_basic_aggregations
), feature_windowing_basic_aggregations AS (
  SELECT
    t1.cdp_uid,
    GREATEST(t2.created_timestamp, t3.created_timestamp, TRY_CAST(t2.golive_at AS TIMESTAMP)) AS created_timestamp
  FROM cdp_identity_resolution AS t1
  INNER JOIN wsdatainnovation.cdp_loan AS t2
    ON t1.agreement_number = t2.agreement_number AND t1.dt = t2.dt
  LEFT JOIN loan_engagement_v2 AS t3
    ON t1.cdp_uid = t3.cdp_uid AND t1.application_id = t3.application_id
), loan_engagement_v2 AS (
  SELECT
    cdp_uid,
    t1.application_id
  FROM cdp_identity_resolution AS t1
  INNER JOIN wsdatainnovation.cdp_los_loan_engagement AS t2
    ON t1.application_id = t2.application_id AND t1.dt = t2.dt
  UNION ALL
  SELECT
    cdp_uid,
    t1.application_id
  FROM cdp_identity_resolution AS t1
  INNER JOIN wsdatainnovation.cdp_lora_loan_engagement AS t2
    ON t1.application_id = t2.application_id AND t1.dt = t2.dt
), ranked_product_per_row AS (
  SELECT
    cdp_uid,
    ts_id, /* 3. Rank the products per customer based on frequency and recency */
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY cdp_uid, ts_id ORDER BY created_timestamp DESC) AS rn
  FROM product_frequencies
  UNION ALL
  SELECT
    cdp_uid,
    TRY_CAST('{bizdate}' AS INT) AS ts_id,
    1 AS rn
  FROM (
    SELECT
      cdp_uid, /* ,FIRST_VALUE(product) OVER (PARTITION BY cdp_uid ORDER BY product_count DESC,latest_product_ts DESC ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW ) AS product_most -- 44 */ /* ,ROW_NUMBER() OVER(PARTITION BY cdp_uid ORDER BY created_timestamp DESC) rn_i */
      MAX(ts_id) AS ts_id
    FROM product_frequencies
    GROUP BY
      cdp_uid
  ) AS t2
  WHERE
    t2.ts_id < TRY_CAST('{bizdate}' AS INT)
), product_frequencies AS (
  SELECT
    t1.cdp_uid,
    TRY_CAST(TIME_TO_STR(TRY_CAST(t2.created_timestamp AS DATETIME), '%Y%m%d') AS INT) AS ts_id,
    t2.created_timestamp
  FROM cdp_identity_resolution AS t1
  INNER JOIN wsDataInnovation.cdp_loan AS t2
    ON t1.agreement_number = t2.agreement_number AND t1.dt = t2.dt
  WHERE
    NOT t2.product IS NULL AND NOT t2.contract_status IN ('CAN', 'PRP', 'RJC')
), ranked_tenor_per_row AS (
  SELECT
    cdp_uid,
    ts_id,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY cdp_uid, ts_id ORDER BY created_timestamp DESC) AS rn
  FROM tenor_frequencies
  UNION ALL
  SELECT
    cdp_uid,
    TRY_CAST('{bizdate}' AS INT) AS ts_id,
    1 AS rn
  FROM (
    SELECT
      cdp_uid, /* ,FIRST_VALUE(tenor) OVER (PARTITION BY cdp_uid ORDER BY tenor_count DESC,latest_ts DESC ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW ) AS tenor_most -- 54 */ /* ,ROW_NUMBER() OVER(PARTITION BY cdp_uid ORDER BY created_timestamp DESC) rn_i */
      MAX(ts_id) AS ts_id
    FROM tenor_frequencies
    GROUP BY
      cdp_uid
  ) AS t2
  WHERE
    t2.ts_id < TRY_CAST('{bizdate}' AS INT)
), tenor_frequencies AS (
  SELECT
    t1.cdp_uid,
    TRY_CAST(TIME_TO_STR(TRY_CAST(t2.created_timestamp AS DATETIME), '%Y%m%d') AS INT) AS ts_id,
    t2.created_timestamp
  FROM cdp_identity_resolution AS t1
  INNER JOIN wsDataInnovation.cdp_loan AS t2
    ON t1.agreement_number = t2.agreement_number AND t1.dt = t2.dt
  WHERE
    NOT t2.tenor IS NULL AND NOT t2.contract_status IN ('CAN', 'PRP', 'RJC')
), ranked_way_financing_per_row AS (
  SELECT
    cdp_uid,
    ts_id,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY cdp_uid, ts_id ORDER BY created_timestamp DESC) AS rn
  FROM way_financing_frequencies
  UNION ALL
  SELECT
    cdp_uid,
    TRY_CAST('{bizdate}' AS INT) AS ts_id, /* '20260702' */
    1 AS rn
  FROM (
    SELECT
      cdp_uid, /* ,FIRST_VALUE(way_of_financing) OVER (PARTITION BY cdp_uid ORDER BY way_financing_count DESC,latest_ts DESC ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW ) AS way_financing_most -- 57 */ /* ,ROW_NUMBER() OVER(PARTITION BY cdp_uid ORDER BY created_timestamp DESC) rn_i */
      MAX(ts_id) AS ts_id
    FROM way_financing_frequencies
    GROUP BY
      cdp_uid
  ) AS t2
  WHERE
    t2.ts_id < TRY_CAST('{bizdate}' AS INT)
), way_financing_frequencies AS (
  SELECT
    t1.cdp_uid,
    TRY_CAST(TIME_TO_STR(TRY_CAST(t2.created_timestamp AS DATETIME), '%Y%m%d') AS INT) AS ts_id,
    t2.created_timestamp
  FROM cdp_identity_resolution AS t1
  INNER JOIN wsDataInnovation.cdp_loan AS t2
    ON t1.agreement_number = t2.agreement_number AND t1.dt = t2.dt
  WHERE
    NOT t2.contract_status IN ('CAN', 'PRP', 'RJC')
), tb6_nunique AS (
  SELECT
    *,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY cdp_uid, ts_id ORDER BY created_timestamp DESC) AS rn
  FROM feature_windowing_nunique
  UNION ALL
  SELECT
    cdp_uid,
    TRY_CAST('{bizdate}' AS INT) AS ts_id, /* '20260702' */
    *
    EXCEPT (cdp_uid, ts_id, created_timestamp),
    1 AS rn
  FROM (
    SELECT
      cdp_uid,
      MAX(ts_id) AS ts_id
    FROM feature_windowing_nunique
    GROUP BY
      cdp_uid
    HAVING
      ts_id < TRY_CAST('{bizdate}' AS INT) /* only refresh the old one */
  )
), feature_windowing_nunique AS (
  SELECT
    cdp_uid,
    TRY_CAST(TIME_TO_STR(TRY_CAST(t2.created_timestamp AS DATETIME), '%Y%m%d') AS INT) AS ts_id,
    created_timestamp
  FROM cdp_identity_resolution AS t1
  INNER JOIN wsdatainnovation.cdp_loan AS t2
    ON t1.agreement_number = t2.agreement_number AND t1.dt = t2.dt
  WHERE
    NOT t2.contract_status IN ('CAN', 'PRP', 'RJC')
)

WITH pre_compute_tab1 AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT
    TRIM(applicationid) AS application_id,
    TRY_CAST(insseqno AS BIGINT) AS installment_no,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY applicationid, insseqno ORDER BY TRY_CAST(paiddate AS DATETIME) DESC) AS rn,
    TRY_CAST(MAX(dtmupd) OVER (PARTITION BY applicationid, insseqno) AS TIMESTAMP) AS event_ts
  FROM wsbfi_2.dwh_ods_installmentschedule_odps
  WHERE
    TRY_CAST(duedate AS DATETIME) <= TRY_CAST(STR_TO_TIME(
      COALESCE(NULLIF('{bizdate}', ''), TIME_TO_STR(CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(), '%Y%m%d')),
      'yyyymmdd'
    ) AS DATETIME)
), pre_compute_tab2 AS (
  SELECT
    application_id,
    installment_no,
    event_ts
  FROM pre_compute_tab1
  WHERE
    rn = 1 /* last installment */
), pre_compute_tab3 AS (
  SELECT
    application_id,
    installment_no, /* installmentno_current */
    event_ts
  FROM pre_compute_tab2
), pre_compute_tab4 AS (
  SELECT
    *, /* application_id, installment_no */
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY application_id ORDER BY installment_no DESC) AS reverse_num
  FROM pre_compute_tab3
), unified_customer_cdp AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT
    tb1.cdp_uid,
    tb1.application_id,
    tb4.confins_customer_id
  FROM wsDataInnovation.cdp_identity_resolution AS tb1
  LEFT JOIN wsDataInnovation.cdp_loan AS tb2
    ON TRIM(tb1.agreement_number) = TRIM(tb2.agreement_number) AND tb1.dt = tb2.dt
  LEFT JOIN wsDataInnovation.cdp_lead AS tb3
    ON tb1.lead_id = tb3.lead_id AND tb1.dt = tb3.dt
  LEFT JOIN wsDataInnovation.cdp_payment_summary AS tb4
    ON tb1.confins_customer_id = tb4.confins_customer_id AND tb1.dt = tb4.dt
  WHERE
    tb1.dt = CASE WHEN '{bizdate}' < '20100101' THEN '2010101' ELSE '{bizdate}' END /* '20260621' -- */
    AND NOT NULLIF(TRIM(tb1.agreement_number), '') IS NULL
    AND NOT tb1.cdp_uid IS NULL
    AND NOT tb1.application_id IS NULL
), feature_view1 AS (
  SELECT
    tb1.*,
    tb2.cdp_uid, /* tb2.confins_customer_id, */ /* tb2.dt, */ /* tb2.agreement_number, */ /* CAST(TO_DATE(tb2.dt, 'yyyymmdd') AS TIMESTAMP) AS event_timestamp, */
    GREATEST(tb1.event_ts, tb2.event_ts) AS event_timestamp
  FROM pre_compute_tab4 AS tb1
  RIGHT JOIN (
    SELECT DISTINCT
      cdp_uid,
      application_id
    FROM unified_customer_cdp
  ) AS tb2
    ON tb1.application_id = tb2.application_id
  WHERE
    installment_no IN (3, 6) /* first_3m and first_6m */
    OR reverse_num = 1 /* alltime: up to last record */
), cdp_payment_fv2 AS (
  SELECT
    alltime.cdp_uid, /* alltime.agreement_number, */
    first_3m.*
    EXCEPT (application_id, installment_no),
    first_6m.*
    EXCEPT (application_id, installment_no),
    alltime.event_timestamp
  FROM (
    SELECT
      *
    FROM feature_view1
    WHERE
      reverse_num = 1
  ) AS alltime
  LEFT JOIN (
    SELECT
      *
    FROM feature_view1
    WHERE
      installment_no = 3
  ) AS first_3m
    ON alltime.application_id = first_3m.application_id
  LEFT JOIN (
    SELECT
      *
    FROM feature_view1
    WHERE
      installment_no = 6
  ) AS first_6m
    ON alltime.application_id = first_6m.application_id
), payment_quality_fv AS (
  SELECT
    cdp_uid,
    MAX(event_timestamp) AS event_timestamp
  FROM cdp_payment_fv2
  GROUP BY
    cdp_uid
)
SELECT
  t1.*,
  t2.*
  EXCEPT (cdp_uid)
FROM payment_quality_fv AS t1
LEFT JOIN (
  SELECT
    tb1.confins_customer_id,
    tb2.cdp_uid
  FROM wsDataInnovation.cdp_payment_summary AS tb1
  RIGHT JOIN unified_customer_cdp AS tb2
    ON tb1.confins_customer_id = tb2.confins_customer_id
  WHERE
    tb1.dt = '{bizdate}' /* '20260621' -- */
  GROUP BY
    cdp_uid
) AS t2
  ON t1.cdp_uid = t2.cdp_uid /* ORDER BY cdp_uid */

WITH cdp_identity_resolution AS (
  SELECT
    dt,
    lead_id,
    cdp_uid,
    application_id
  FROM wsDataInnovation.cdp_identity_resolution
  WHERE
    dt = CASE WHEN '{bizdate}' < '20100101' THEN '20100101' ELSE '{bizdate}' END
    AND NOT cdp_uid IS NULL
    AND NOT lead_id IS NULL
  GROUP BY
    dt,
    cdp_uid,
    lead_id,
    application_id
), all_phone_stored AS (
  SELECT
    t1.*,
    TRIM(phone_number) AS phone_number,
    COALESCE(t2.updated_timestamp, t2.created_timestamp) AS phone_registered_time
  FROM cdp_identity_resolution AS t1
  LEFT JOIN wsDataInnovation.cdp_lead AS t2
    ON t1.dt = t2.dt AND t1.lead_id = t2.lead_id
  WHERE
    NOT NULLIF(TRIM(phone_number), '') IS NULL
  UNION
  SELECT
    t1.*,
    TRIM(spouse_phone_number) AS phone_number,
    COALESCE(t2.updated_timestamp, t2.created_timestamp) AS phone_registered_time
  FROM cdp_identity_resolution AS t1
  LEFT JOIN wsDataInnovation.cdp_lead AS t2
    ON t1.dt = t2.dt AND t1.lead_id = t2.lead_id
  WHERE
    NOT NULLIF(TRIM(spouse_phone_number), '') IS NULL
), phone_unique_record AS (
  SELECT
    *
    EXCEPT (rn)
  FROM (
    SELECT
      *
    FROM all_phone_stored
  ) AS sq
  WHERE
    sq.rn = 1
), phone_record_tab2 AS (
  SELECT
    cdp_uid,
    CAST(phone_registered_time AS TEXT) AS ts_id,
    phone_registered_time
  FROM phone_unique_record
  UNION
  SELECT
    cdp_uid,
    '{bizdate}' AS ts_id,
    TRY_CAST(STR_TO_TIME('{bizdate}', 'yyyymmdd') AS TIMESTAMP) AS phone_registered_time
  FROM (
    SELECT
      cdp_uid, /* single copy */
      MAX(phone_registered_time) AS phone_registered_time
    FROM phone_unique_record
    GROUP BY
      cdp_uid
  ) AS t2
  WHERE
    DATEDIFF(
      TRY_CAST(CAST('{bizdate}' AS DATE) AS DATETIME),
      TRY_CAST(t2.phone_registered_time AS DATETIME),
      DD
    ) > 0
), customer_phone_tab3 AS (
  SELECT
    *,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY cdp_uid, ts_id ORDER BY phone_registered_time DESC) AS rn
  FROM phone_record_tab2
), customer_phone_aggregate AS (
  SELECT
    cdp_uid,
    ts_id,
    phone_registered_time AS created_timestamp
  FROM customer_phone_tab3
  WHERE
    rn = 1
), wab_message_prep1 AS (
  SELECT
    t2.cdp_uid,
    t1.lead_id,
    direction AS wab_direction,
    'sent' AS record_type,
    sent_at AS created_timestamp
  FROM wsDataInnovation.cdp_wab_message AS t1
  INNER JOIN cdp_identity_resolution AS t2
    ON t1.dt = t2.dt AND t1.lead_id = t2.lead_id
  UNION
  SELECT
    t2.cdp_uid,
    t1.lead_id,
    direction AS wab_direction,
    'submitted' AS record_type,
    submitted_at AS created_timestamp
  FROM wsDataInnovation.cdp_wab_message AS t1
  INNER JOIN cdp_identity_resolution AS t2
    ON t1.dt = t2.dt AND t1.lead_id = t2.lead_id
  UNION
  SELECT
    t2.cdp_uid,
    t1.lead_id,
    direction AS wab_direction,
    'delivered' AS record_type,
    delivered_at AS created_timestamp
  FROM wsDataInnovation.cdp_wab_message AS t1
  INNER JOIN cdp_identity_resolution AS t2
    ON t1.dt = t2.dt AND t1.lead_id = t2.lead_id
  UNION
  SELECT
    t2.cdp_uid,
    t1.lead_id,
    direction AS wab_direction,
    'read' AS record_type,
    read_at AS created_timestamp
  FROM wsDataInnovation.cdp_wab_message AS t1
  INNER JOIN cdp_identity_resolution AS t2
    ON t1.dt = t2.dt AND t1.lead_id = t2.lead_id
), wab_message_prep2 AS (
  SELECT
    *
    EXCEPT (lead_id),
    CAST(created_timestamp AS TEXT) AS ts_id,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
      PARTITION BY cdp_uid, lead_id, wab_direction, record_type, STR_TO_UNIX(created_timestamp, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S')
      ORDER BY created_timestamp
    ) AS rn
  FROM wab_message_prep1
  WHERE
    NOT created_timestamp IS NULL
), wab_message_prep2b AS (
  SELECT
    cdp_uid,
    ts_id,
    created_timestamp
  FROM wab_message_prep2
  WHERE
    rn = 1 /* unique record */
), wab_message_prep3 AS (
  SELECT
    cdp_uid, /* ,lead_id */
    ts_id,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY cdp_uid, ts_id ORDER BY created_timestamp) AS rn
  FROM (
    SELECT
      *
    FROM wab_message_prep2b
    UNION
    SELECT
      cdp_uid,
      MAX(ts_id) AS ts_id
    FROM wab_message_prep2b
    GROUP BY
      cdp_uid
    HAVING
      TRY_CAST(ts_id AS INT) < TRY_CAST('{bizdate}' AS INT)
  )
), wab_message_feat4 AS (
  SELECT
    *
    EXCEPT (rn)
  FROM wab_message_prep3
  WHERE
    rn = 1 /* single copy of each entity */
), followup_summary_prep1 AS (
  SELECT
    t2.cdp_uid,
    CAST(created_timestamp AS TEXT) AS ts_id,
    t1.*
    EXCEPT (created_timestamp),
    t1.created_timestamp,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY cdp_uid ORDER BY created_timestamp DESC) AS rn
  FROM wsDataInnovation.cdp_loan_engagement_follow_up_summary AS t1
  INNER JOIN cdp_identity_resolution AS t2
    ON t1.dt = t2.dt AND t1.application_id = t2.application_id
), followup_summary_prep2 AS (
  SELECT
    *
    EXCEPT (rn)
  FROM followup_summary_prep1
  UNION
  SELECT
    cdp_uid,
    '{bizdate}' AS ts_id,
    *
    EXCEPT (cdp_uid, ts_id, created_timestamp, rn),
    TRY_CAST(STR_TO_TIME('{bizdate}', 'yyyymmdd') AS TIMESTAMP) AS created_timestamp
  FROM followup_summary_prep1 AS t2
  WHERE
    t2.rn = 1
    AND TRY_CAST(t2.ts_id AS INT) < TRY_CAST('{bizdate}' AS INT) /* only refresh the old one */
), followup_summary_prep3 AS (
  SELECT
    cdp_uid,
    CAST(created_timestamp AS TEXT) AS ts_id,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY cdp_uid, ts_id ORDER BY created_timestamp DESC) AS rn
  FROM followup_summary_prep2 AS fu
), last_conversation_tab1 AS (
  SELECT
    cdp_uid,
    GREATEST(created_timestamp, first_call_at) AS created_timestamp
  FROM followup_summary_prep2
  WHERE
    NOT first_call_at IS NULL
  UNION
  SELECT
    cdp_uid,
    GREATEST(created_timestamp, first_follow_up_creating_schedule) AS created_timestamp
  FROM followup_summary_prep2
  WHERE
    NOT first_follow_up_creating_schedule IS NULL
  UNION
  SELECT
    cdp_uid,
    GREATEST(created_timestamp, first_customer_response_creating_schedule) AS created_timestamp
  FROM followup_summary_prep2
  UNION
  SELECT
    cdp_uid,
    GREATEST(created_timestamp, first_follow_up) AS created_timestamp
  FROM followup_summary_prep2
  WHERE
    NOT first_follow_up IS NULL
  UNION
  SELECT
    cdp_uid,
    GREATEST(created_timestamp, first_customer_response) AS created_timestamp
  FROM followup_summary_prep2
  WHERE
    NOT first_customer_response IS NULL
  UNION
  SELECT
    cdp_uid,
    GREATEST(created_timestamp, first_time_initiate_appointment_at) AS created_timestamp
  FROM followup_summary_prep2
  WHERE
    NOT first_time_initiate_appointment_at IS NULL
), last_conversation_tab2 AS (
  SELECT
    *
    EXCEPT (last_conversation_recorded_at),
    CAST(created_timestamp AS TEXT) AS ts_id
  FROM last_conversation_tab1
), last_conversation_tab3 AS (
  SELECT
    *,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY cdp_uid, ts_id ORDER BY created_timestamp DESC) AS rn
  FROM last_conversation_tab2
), error_frequencies AS (
  SELECT
    t1.cdp_uid,
    TIME_TO_STR(TRY_CAST(t2.created_timestamp AS DATETIME), '%Y%m%d') AS ts_id,
    t2.created_timestamp
  FROM cdp_identity_resolution AS t1
  INNER JOIN wsDataInnovation.cdp_loan_engagement_follow_up_summary AS t2
    ON t1.dt = t2.dt AND t1.application_id = t2.application_id
  WHERE
    NOT t2.error_code IS NULL
), ranked_error_per_row AS (
  SELECT
    cdp_uid,
    ts_id,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY cdp_uid, ts_id ORDER BY created_timestamp DESC) AS rn
  FROM error_frequencies
  UNION
  SELECT
    cdp_uid,
    '{bizdate}' AS ts_id,
    1 AS rn
  FROM (
    SELECT
      cdp_uid,
      MAX(TRY_CAST(ts_id AS INT)) AS ts_id
    FROM error_frequencies
    GROUP BY
      cdp_uid
  ) AS t2
  WHERE
    TRY_CAST(t2.ts_id AS INT) < TRY_CAST('{bizdate}' AS INT)
), cdp_combination_ts AS (
  SELECT
    cdp_uid,
    ts_id
  FROM customer_phone_aggregate
  UNION
  SELECT
    cdp_uid,
    ts_id
  FROM wab_message_feat4
  UNION
  SELECT
    cdp_uid,
    ts_id
  FROM followup_summary_prep3
  WHERE
    rn = 1
), feature_subset1 AS (
  SELECT
    t2.*
    EXCEPT (cdp_uid, ts_id, created_timestamp),
    t3.*
    EXCEPT (cdp_uid, ts_id, created_timestamp),
    t4.*
    EXCEPT (cdp_uid, ts_id, created_timestamp, rn),
    GREATEST(
      t2.created_timestamp,
      t3.created_timestamp,
      t4.created_timestamp,
      t5.created_timestamp,
      t6.created_timestamp
    ) AS event_timestamp
  FROM (
    SELECT
      *
    FROM cdp_combination_ts
    GROUP BY
      cdp_uid,
      ts_id
  ) AS t1
  LEFT JOIN customer_phone_aggregate AS t2
    ON t1.cdp_uid = t2.cdp_uid AND t1.ts_id = t2.ts_id
  LEFT JOIN wab_message_feat4 AS t3
    ON t1.cdp_uid = t3.cdp_uid AND t1.ts_id = t3.ts_id
  LEFT JOIN followup_summary_prep3 AS t4
    ON t4.rn = 1 AND t4.cdp_uid = t1.cdp_uid AND t4.ts_id = t1.ts_id
  LEFT JOIN last_conversation_tab3 AS t5
    ON t5.rn = 1 AND t5.cdp_uid = t1.cdp_uid AND t5.ts_id = t1.ts_id
  LEFT JOIN ranked_error_per_row AS t6
    ON t6.cdp_uid = t1.cdp_uid AND t6.ts_id = t1.ts_id AND t6.rn = 1
), feature_subset2 AS (
  SELECT
    *
  FROM feature_subset1
  WHERE
    NOT event_timestamp IS NULL
)
SELECT
  event_timestamp
FROM feature_subset2

WITH one_source_agreement AS (

), asset_prep1 AS (
  SELECT
    t1.agreement_number,
    t2.*
    EXCEPT (dt, agreement_number),
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY t1.agreement_number ORDER BY created_timestamp DESC) AS rn
  FROM one_source_agreement AS t1
  INNER JOIN wsDataInnovation.cdp_asset AS t2
    ON t1.dt = t2.dt AND t1.agreement_number = t2.agreement_number
), asset_prep2 AS (
  SELECT
    agreement_number,
    TIME_TO_STR(TRY_CAST(created_timestamp AS DATETIME), '%Y%m%d') AS ts_id,
    created_timestamp AS event_timestamp
  FROM asset_prep1
  UNION ALL
  SELECT
    agreement_number,
    '{bizdate}' AS ts_id,
    TRY_CAST(STR_TO_TIME('{bizdate}', 'yyyymmdd') AS TIMESTAMP) AS event_timestamp
  FROM asset_prep1 AS t2
  WHERE

), contract_asset_feat AS (
  SELECT
    MAX(event_timestamp) OVER (PARTITION BY agreement_number, ts_id) AS event_timestamp,

WITH loan_snapshot AS (
  SELECT
    TRIM(agreement_number) AS agreement_number,
    created_timestamp AS loan_created_timestamp
  FROM wsDataInnovation.cdp_loan
  WHERE
    dt = '{bizdate}'
    AND NOT agreement_number IS NULL
    AND CAST(created_timestamp AS TEXT) <> '1900'
), loan_ts_grid AS (
  SELECT
    agreement_number,
    CAST(loan_created_timestamp AS TEXT) AS ts_id
  FROM loan_snapshot
  WHERE
    NOT loan_created_timestamp IS NULL
), collection_scan AS (
  SELECT
    TRIM(agreement_number) AS agreement_number,
    dt AS ts_id,
    COALESCE(
      CASE
        WHEN CAST(GREATEST(updated_timestamp, created_timestamp) AS TEXT) = '1900'
        THEN NULL
        ELSE GREATEST(updated_timestamp, created_timestamp)
      END,
      TRY_CAST(STR_TO_TIME(dt, 'yyyymmdd') AS TIMESTAMP)
    ) AS raw_event_timestamp
  FROM wsDataInnovation.cdp_collection
  WHERE
    dt <= '{bizdate}' AND NOT agreement_number IS NULL
), loan_scan AS (
  SELECT
    TRIM(agreement_number) AS agreement_number,
    dt AS ts_id,
    COALESCE(
      CASE
        WHEN CAST(created_timestamp AS TEXT) = '1900'
        THEN NULL
        ELSE created_timestamp
      END,
      TRY_CAST(STR_TO_TIME(dt, 'yyyymmdd') AS TIMESTAMP)
    ) AS raw_event_timestamp
  FROM wsDataInnovation.cdp_loan
  WHERE
    dt <= '{bizdate}' AND NOT agreement_number IS NULL
), collection_ts_grid AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT
    agreement_number,
    ts_id
  FROM collection_scan
  UNION
  SELECT DISTINCT
    agreement_number,
    ts_id
  FROM loan_scan
), combined_ts_grid AS (
  SELECT
    agreement_number,
    ts_id
  FROM loan_ts_grid
  UNION
  SELECT
    agreement_number,
    ts_id
  FROM collection_ts_grid
  UNION
  SELECT
    agreement_number,
    '{bizdate}' AS ts_id
  FROM loan_snapshot
), collection_agg AS (
  SELECT
    agreement_number,
    ts_id,
    MAX(raw_event_timestamp) AS collection_event_timestamp
  FROM collection_scan
  GROUP BY
    agreement_number,
    ts_id
), loan_agg AS (
  SELECT
    agreement_number,
    ts_id,
    MAX(raw_event_timestamp) AS loan_event_timestamp
  FROM loan_scan
  GROUP BY
    agreement_number,
    ts_id
), joined AS (
  SELECT
    COALESCE(
      ca.collection_event_timestamp,
      la.loan_event_timestamp,
      TRY_CAST(STR_TO_TIME(g.ts_id, 'yyyymmdd') AS TIMESTAMP)
    ) AS raw_event_timestamp
  FROM (
    SELECT DISTINCT
      agreement_number,
      ts_id
    FROM combined_ts_grid
  ) AS g
  LEFT JOIN collection_agg AS ca
    ON g.agreement_number = ca.agreement_number AND g.ts_id = ca.ts_id
  LEFT JOIN loan_agg AS la
    ON g.agreement_number = la.agreement_number AND g.ts_id = la.ts_id
), forward_filled AS (
  SELECT
    LAST_VALUE(raw_event_timestamp) IGNORE NULLS OVER w AS event_timestamp
  FROM joined
)
SELECT
  event_timestamp
FROM forward_filled

WITH ir_dedup AS (

WITH score AS (
  SELECT
    MAX(TRY_CAST(s._load_timestamp AS TIMESTAMP)) AS last_score_timestamp
  FROM wsdatainnovation.cdp_score AS s
  INNER JOIN wsdatainnovation.cdp_loan AS l
    ON s.application_id = l.application_id AND l.dt = '{bizdate}'

)
SELECT

WITH installment AS (
  SELECT
    i.applicationid,
    TRY_CAST(i.duedate AS DATETIME) AS duedate,
    TRY_CAST(i.paiddate AS DATETIME) AS paiddate,
    CASE
      WHEN i.paiddate IS NULL
      THEN 'MISSED'
      WHEN i.paiddate < i.duedate
      THEN 'EARLY'
      WHEN i.paiddate = i.duedate
      THEN 'ONTIME'
      ELSE 'LATE'
    END AS payment_status
  FROM wsbfi_2.dwh_ods_installmentschedule_odps AS i
  WHERE
    TRY_CAST(i.duedate AS DATETIME) <= TRY_CAST(STR_TO_TIME('{bizdate}', 'yyyymmdd') AS DATETIME)
), stg_agreement AS (
  SELECT
    application_id,
    confins_customer_id
  FROM (
    SELECT
      applicationid AS application_id,
      TRIM(customerid) AS confins_customer_id
    FROM wsbfi_2.confins_stg_agreement_odps
    WHERE
      TRIM(agreementno) <> '-' AND NOT golivedate IS NULL
  ) AS t
  WHERE
    rn = 1
), mapped AS (
  SELECT
    sa.confins_customer_id,
    ins.duedate,
    ins.paiddate,
    ins.payment_status
  FROM installment AS ins
  INNER JOIN stg_agreement AS sa
    ON TRY_CAST(ins.applicationid AS TEXT) = sa.application_id
), events AS (
  SELECT
    confins_customer_id,
    CAST(duedate AS TEXT) AS ts_id
  FROM mapped
  WHERE
    payment_status IN ('MISSED', 'LATE')
  UNION
  SELECT
    confins_customer_id,
    CAST(paiddate AS TEXT) AS ts_id
  FROM mapped
  WHERE
    payment_status IN ('EARLY', 'ONTIME')
  UNION
  SELECT
    confins_customer_id,
    CAST(paiddate AS TEXT) AS ts_id
  FROM mapped
  WHERE
    payment_status = 'LATE'
), event_agg AS (
  SELECT
    confins_customer_id,
    ts_id
  FROM events
  GROUP BY
    confins_customer_id,
    ts_id
), customer_ts_grid AS (
  SELECT
    confins_customer_id,
    ts_id
  FROM event_agg
  UNION
  SELECT
    confins_customer_id,
    '{bizdate}' AS ts_id
  FROM (
    SELECT
      confins_customer_id
    FROM event_agg
    GROUP BY
      confins_customer_id
  ) AS t
  WHERE
    t.last_ts_id < '{bizdate}'
), joined AS (
  SELECT
    g.ts_id
  FROM (
    SELECT DISTINCT
      ts_id
    FROM customer_ts_grid
  ) AS g
  LEFT JOIN event_agg AS ea
    ON g.confins_customer_id = ea.confins_customer_id AND g.ts_id = ea.ts_id
)
SELECT
  TRY_CAST(STR_TO_TIME(ts_id, 'yyyymmdd') AS TIMESTAMP) AS event_timestamp
FROM joined

WITH lookup_window_init AS (

    NULLIF(TRIM(confins_application_id), '') AS applicationid,

    NULLIF(TRIM(confins_customer_id), '') AS customerid,

    GREATEST(golive_at, TRY_CAST(lon.application_date AS DATETIME)) AS event_timestamp,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
      PARTITION BY COALESCE(application_id, lon.agreement_number), confins_customer_id, product, asset_type_id

), RO_DF_prep1 AS (
  SELECT
    *
    EXCEPT (rn),
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY customerid ORDER BY event_timestamp) AS rn /* re-occurence index */
  FROM lookup_window_init
  WHERE
    customerid IN (
      SELECT
        customerid
      FROM lookup_window_init
      WHERE
        productname = 'DF'
        AND productgroup = 'MOBIL'
        AND (
          TRY_CAST(event_timestamp AS DATETIME) BETWEEN STR_TO_TIME('20210101', 'yyyymmdd') AND STR_TO_TIME('{bizdate}', 'yyyymmdd')
        )
    )
    AND rn = 1
), RO_DF_prep2 AS (
  SELECT
    *,
    LAG(COALESCE(applicationid, agreementno), 1) OVER (PARTITION BY customerid ORDER BY event_timestamp) AS prev_contract,
    LEAD(COALESCE(applicationid, agreementno), 1) OVER (PARTITION BY customerid ORDER BY event_timestamp) AS next_contract,
    COALESCE(
      TS_OR_DS_ADD(
        LEAD(event_timestamp, 1) OVER (PARTITION BY customerid ORDER BY event_timestamp),
        -1,
        DD
      ),
      STR_TO_TIME('{bizdate}', 'yyyymmdd')
    ) AS upper_time_limit
  FROM RO_DF_prep1
), RO_DF_feat3 AS (
  SELECT
    rdp.*,
    col.created_timestamp AS collection_created,
    col.updated_timestamp AS collection_updated, /* customer demography */
    LEAST(led.lead_created_at, led.created_timestamp) AS lead_created,
    led.updated_timestamp AS lead_updated, /* fee */
    TRY_CAST(lon.created_timestamp AS DATETIME) AS loan_inserted, /* loan outstanding */
    pay.created_timestamp AS payment_created,
    pay.updated_timestamp AS payment_updated, /* asset */
    ast.created_timestamp AS asset_registered,
    pef.created_timestamp AS pefindo_created,
    pef.updated_timestamp AS pefindo_updated
  FROM RO_DF_prep2 AS rdp
  LEFT JOIN wsdatainnovation.cdp_loan AS lon
    ON lon.agreement_number = rdp.agreementno
    AND lon.dt = rdp.dt
    AND TRY_CAST(lon.created_timestamp AS DATETIME) < rdp.upper_time_limit
  LEFT JOIN wsbfi_2.dwh_vw_dim_region_odps AS vdr
    ON TRIM(lon.branch_id) = TRIM(vdr.id_branch)
    AND TRY_CAST(rdp.event_timestamp AS DATETIME) BETWEEN vdr.effective_date AND COALESCE(vdr.expiration_date, STR_TO_TIME('{bizdate}', 'yyyymmdd'))
  LEFT JOIN wsDataInnovation.cdp_asset AS ast
    ON ast.agreement_number = rdp.agreementno
    AND ast.dt = rdp.dt
    AND TRY_CAST(ast.created_timestamp AS DATETIME) < rdp.upper_time_limit
  LEFT JOIN wsDataInnovation.cdp_lead AS led
    ON led.confins_customer_id = rdp.customerid
    AND led.dt = rdp.dt
    AND GREATEST(led.updated_timestamp, led.created_timestamp) < TRY_CAST(rdp.upper_time_limit AS TIMESTAMP)
  LEFT JOIN wsDataInnovation.cdp_collection AS col
    ON col.agreement_number = rdp.agreementno
    AND col.dt = rdp.dt
    AND GREATEST(col.updated_timestamp, col.created_timestamp) < TRY_CAST(rdp.upper_time_limit AS TIMESTAMP)
  LEFT JOIN wsDataInnovation.cdp_score AS pef
    ON pef.application_id = rdp.applicationid
    AND pef.dt = rdp.dt
    AND GREATEST(pef.updated_timestamp, pef.created_timestamp) < TRY_CAST(rdp.upper_time_limit AS TIMESTAMP)
  LEFT JOIN wsDataInnovation.cdp_payment_summary AS pay
    ON pay.confins_customer_id = rdp.customerid
    AND pay.dt = rdp.dt
    AND GREATEST(pay.updated_timestamp, pay.created_timestamp) < TRY_CAST(rdp.upper_time_limit AS TIMESTAMP)
  LEFT JOIN wsbfi_2.confins_stg_agreement_odps AS csa
    ON TRIM(csa.applicationid) = rdp.applicationid
  LEFT JOIN wsDataInnovation.cdp_identity_resolution AS idr
    ON TRIM(idr.agreement_number) = rdp.agreementno AND idr.dt = rdp.dt
  LEFT JOIN wsbfi_2.dwh_dim_supplier_odps AS sup
    ON TRIM(csa.supplierid) = TRIM(sup.id_supplier)
    AND TRY_CAST(rdp.event_timestamp AS DATETIME) BETWEEN sup.effective_date AND COALESCE(sup.expiration_date, STR_TO_TIME('{bizdate}', 'yyyymmdd'))
), RO_DF_final AS (
  SELECT
    *
    EXCEPT (rn),
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
      PARTITION BY customerid, COALESCE(applicationid, agreementno), productname, productgroup, rn, prev_contract, next_contract
      ORDER BY GREATEST(
        TRY_CAST(loan_inserted AS TIMESTAMP),
        asset_registered,
        COALESCE(lead_updated, lead_created),
        COALESCE(payment_updated, payment_created),
        COALESCE(pefindo_updated, pefindo_created),
        COALESCE(collection_updated, collection_created)
      )
    ) AS rn
  FROM RO_DF_feat3
), feature_set AS (
  SELECT
    TRY_CAST(event_timestamp AS TIMESTAMP) AS event_timestamp
  FROM RO_DF_final
  WHERE
    rn = 1
), test_case AS (
  SELECT
    *
    EXCEPT (idx, event_timestamp), /* reorder field */
    event_timestamp
  FROM feature_set
)
SELECT
  *
FROM test_case

WITH joined AS (
  SELECT
    g.phone_number,
    g.ts_id,
    COALESCE(fa.raw_event_timestamp, TRY_CAST(STR_TO_TIME(g.ts_id, 'yyyymmdd') AS TIMESTAMP)) AS raw_event_timestamp
  FROM (
    SELECT DISTINCT
      phone_number,
      ts_id
    FROM combined_ts_grid
  ) AS g
  LEFT JOIN followup_agg AS fa
    ON g.phone_number = fa.phone_number AND g.ts_id = fa.ts_id
  LEFT JOIN error_agg_dedup AS ea
    ON g.phone_number = ea.phone_number AND g.ts_id = ea.ts_id
), combined_ts_grid AS (
  SELECT
    phone_number,
    ts_id
  FROM phone_ts_grid
  UNION
  SELECT
    phone_number,
    ts_id
  FROM followup_ts_grid
  UNION
  SELECT
    phone_number,
    ts_id
  FROM followup_multi_ts_grid
  UNION
  SELECT
    phone_number,
    ts_id
  FROM error_ts_grid
), phone_ts_grid AS (
  SELECT
    phone_number,
    CAST(phone_registered_time AS TEXT) AS ts_id
  FROM phone_unique_record
  UNION
  SELECT
    phone_number,
    '{bizdate}' AS ts_id
  FROM (
    SELECT
      phone_number
    FROM phone_unique_record
    GROUP BY
      phone_number
  ) AS t
  WHERE
    DATEDIFF(
      TRY_CAST(STR_TO_TIME('{bizdate}', 'yyyymmdd') AS DATETIME),
      TRY_CAST(t.last_registered AS DATETIME),
      DD
    ) > 0
), phone_unique_record AS (
  SELECT
    *
    EXCEPT (rn)
  FROM (
    SELECT
      aps.*
    FROM valid_phone_stored AS aps
    WHERE
      NOT aps.phone_registered_time IS NULL
  ) AS sq
  WHERE
    sq.rn = 1
), valid_phone_stored AS (
  SELECT
    *
  FROM all_phone_stored
  WHERE
    NOT phone_number IS NULL
    AND NOT TRIM(phone_number) IN ('', '-', '0', '00', '000', '0000', '00000', '000000', '000000000000')
    AND LENGTH(TRIM(phone_number)) >= 8
    AND NOT REGEXP_LIKE(TRIM(phone_number), '^0*$')
), all_phone_stored AS (
  SELECT
    t1.phone_number,
    cir.application_id,
    COALESCE(t2.updated_timestamp, t2.created_timestamp) AS phone_registered_time
  FROM (
    SELECT
      phone_number
    FROM wsDataInnovation.cdp_lead
    WHERE
      dt = '{bizdate}' AND NOT phone_number IS NULL AND NOT lead_id IS NULL
    UNION
    SELECT
      spouse_phone_number AS phone_number
    FROM wsDataInnovation.cdp_lead
    WHERE
      dt = '{bizdate}' AND NOT spouse_phone_number IS NULL AND NOT lead_id IS NULL
    UNION
    SELECT
      phone_number
    FROM wsDataInnovation.cdp_identity_resolution
    WHERE
      dt = '{bizdate}' AND NOT phone_number IS NULL AND NOT lead_id IS NULL
  ) AS t1
  LEFT JOIN wsDataInnovation.cdp_lead AS t2
    ON t1.lead_id = t2.lead_id AND t2.dt = '{bizdate}'
  LEFT JOIN cir_snapshot AS cir
    ON t1.lead_id = cir.lead_id
), cir_snapshot AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT
    lead_id,
    application_id
  FROM wsDataInnovation.cdp_identity_resolution
  WHERE
    dt = '{bizdate}' AND NOT lead_id IS NULL
), followup_ts_grid AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT
    phone_number,
    CAST(created_timestamp AS TEXT) AS ts_id
  FROM followup_snapshot
  WHERE
    NOT created_timestamp IS NULL
), followup_snapshot AS (
  SELECT
    pam.phone_number,
    fu.*
  FROM phone_app_map AS pam
  INNER JOIN wsDataInnovation.cdp_loan_engagement_follow_up_summary AS fu
    ON pam.application_id = fu.application_id AND fu.dt = '{bizdate}'
), phone_app_map AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT
    phone_number,
    application_id
  FROM valid_phone_stored
  WHERE
    NOT application_id IS NULL
), followup_multi_ts_grid AS (
  SELECT
    phone_number,
    CAST(first_call_at AS TEXT) AS ts_id
  FROM followup_snapshot
  WHERE
    NOT first_call_at IS NULL
  UNION
  SELECT
    phone_number,
    CAST(first_follow_up_creating_schedule AS TEXT) AS ts_id
  FROM followup_snapshot
  WHERE
    NOT first_follow_up_creating_schedule IS NULL
  UNION
  SELECT
    phone_number,
    CAST(first_customer_response_creating_schedule AS TEXT) AS ts_id
  FROM followup_snapshot
  WHERE
    NOT first_customer_response_creating_schedule IS NULL
  UNION
  SELECT
    phone_number,
    CAST(first_follow_up AS TEXT) AS ts_id
  FROM followup_snapshot
  WHERE
    NOT first_follow_up IS NULL
  UNION
  SELECT
    phone_number,
    CAST(first_customer_response AS TEXT) AS ts_id
  FROM followup_snapshot
  WHERE
    NOT first_customer_response IS NULL
  UNION
  SELECT
    phone_number,
    CAST(first_time_initiate_appointment_at AS TEXT) AS ts_id
  FROM followup_snapshot
  WHERE
    NOT first_time_initiate_appointment_at IS NULL
), error_ts_grid AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT
    phone_number,
    ts_id
  FROM error_codes
), error_codes AS (
  SELECT
    pam.phone_number,
    fu.dt AS ts_id
  FROM phone_app_map AS pam
  INNER JOIN wsDataInnovation.cdp_loan_engagement_follow_up_summary AS fu
    ON pam.application_id = fu.application_id AND fu.dt = '{bizdate}'
  WHERE
    NOT fu.error_code IS NULL
  GROUP BY
    pam.phone_number,
    fu.dt,
    fu.error_code
), followup_agg AS (
  SELECT
    fs.phone_number,
    ftg.ts_id,
    MAX(
      CASE
        WHEN CAST(fs.created_timestamp AS TEXT) <= ftg.ts_id
        THEN fs.created_timestamp
      END
    ) AS raw_event_timestamp
  FROM followup_ts_grid AS ftg
  INNER JOIN followup_snapshot AS fs
    ON ftg.phone_number = fs.phone_number
  GROUP BY
    fs.phone_number,
    ftg.ts_id
), error_agg_dedup AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT
    phone_number,
    ts_id
  FROM error_agg
), error_agg AS (
  SELECT
    etg.phone_number,
    etg.ts_id
  FROM error_ts_grid AS etg
  INNER JOIN error_codes AS ec
    ON etg.phone_number = ec.phone_number AND etg.ts_id = ec.ts_id
)
SELECT
  LAST_VALUE(raw_event_timestamp) IGNORE NULLS OVER (
    PARTITION BY phone_number
    ORDER BY ts_id
    ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW
  ) AS event_timestamp
FROM joined

WITH filtered_dim_supplier AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT
    NULLIF(TRIM(id_supplier), '') AS supplier_id,
    UPPER(TRIM(supplier)) AS supplier_name,
    TRY_CAST(effective_date AS TIMESTAMP) AS created_timestamp,
    sk_supplier,
    sk_region,
    expiration_date
  FROM wsBFI_2.dwh_dim_supplier_odps
  WHERE
    row_is_current_ind = TRUE
    OR expiration_date >= TS_OR_DS_ADD(STR_TO_TIME('{bizdate}', 'yyyymmdd'), -15, YYYY)
), filtered_agreement_prep0 AS (
  SELECT
    t1.supplier_id,
    NULLIF(TRIM(t2.applicationid), '') AS application_id,
    NULLIF(TRIM(t2.agreementno), '') AS agreement_number,
    GREATEST(newapplicationdate, approvaldate, agreementdate, effectivedate, golivedate) AS event_ts,
    productid
  FROM (
    SELECT
      supplier_id
    FROM filtered_dim_supplier
  ) AS t1
  INNER JOIN wsbfi_2.confins_stg_agreement_odps AS t2
    ON t1.supplier_id = NULLIF(TRIM(t2.supplierid), '')
), filtered_agreement_odps AS (
  SELECT
    *,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
      PARTITION BY COALESCE(application_id, agreement_number), supplier_id
      ORDER BY event_ts
    ) AS rn
  FROM filtered_agreement_prep0
), filtered_fact_contract AS (
  SELECT
    t2.sk_supplier,
    NULLIF(TRIM(id_application), '') AS application_id,
    NULLIF(TRIM(agreementno), '') AS agreement_number,
    STR_TO_TIME(
      TRY_CAST(GREATEST(sk_approval_date, sk_agreementdate, sk_application_date, sk_golive_date) AS TEXT),
      'yyyymmdd'
    ) AS event_ts,
    sk_product
  FROM wsBFI_2.dwh_fact_contract_odps AS t1
  INNER JOIN (
    SELECT
      sk_supplier
    FROM filtered_dim_supplier
  ) AS t2
    ON t1.sk_supplier = t2.sk_supplier
), supplier_join_contract AS (
  SELECT
    t1.*,
    t5.*
    EXCEPT (supplier_id, sk_supplier, rn)
  FROM filtered_dim_supplier AS t1
  LEFT JOIN (
    SELECT
      COALESCE(t2.agreement_number, t3.agreement_number) AS agreement_number,
      t2.*
      EXCEPT (agreement_number, application_id, event_ts, supplier_rate),
      t3.*
      EXCEPT (agreement_number, application_id, event_ts, supplier_rate),
      GREATEST(t2.event_ts, t3.event_ts) AS contract_timestamp
    FROM (
      SELECT
        *
        EXCEPT (rn)
      FROM filtered_agreement_odps
      WHERE
        rn = 1
    ) AS t2
    FULL JOIN filtered_fact_contract AS t3
      ON t2.agreement_number = t3.agreement_number
  ) AS t5
    ON t1.supplier_id = t5.supplier_id AND t1.sk_supplier = t5.sk_supplier
  LEFT JOIN wsbfi_2.dwh_vw_dim_product_odps AS vdp1
    ON TRY_CAST(TRIM(t5.productid) AS INT) = vdp1.id_product
    AND TRY_CAST(t5.contract_timestamp AS DATETIME) BETWEEN vdp1.effective_date AND COALESCE(vdp1.expiration_date, STR_TO_TIME('{bizdate}', 'yyyymmdd'))
  LEFT JOIN wsbfi_2.dwh_vw_dim_product_odps AS vdp2
    ON TRY_CAST(TRIM(t5.sk_product) AS INT) = vdp2.sk_product
    AND TRY_CAST(t5.contract_timestamp AS DATETIME) BETWEEN vdp2.effective_date AND COALESCE(vdp2.expiration_date, STR_TO_TIME('{bizdate}', 'yyyymmdd'))
  WHERE
    t5.rn = 1
), joined_prep0 AS (
  SELECT
    supplier_id,
    supplier_name,
    sk_supplier,
    sk_region,
    expiration_date,
    CAST(created_timestamp AS TEXT) AS ts_id,
    created_timestamp,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
      PARTITION BY supplier_id, supplier_name, sk_supplier, sk_region, STR_TO_UNIX(created_timestamp, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S')
      ORDER BY created_timestamp DESC
    ) AS rn
  FROM supplier_join_contract
  WHERE
    NOT created_timestamp IS NULL
), joined_table_prep1 AS (
  SELECT
    COALESCE(t1.supplier_id, t2.supplier_id) AS supplier_id,
    COALESCE(t1.sk_supplier, t2.sk_supplier) AS sk_supplier,
    COALESCE(t1.sk_region, t2.sk_region) AS sk_region,
    COALESCE(t1.ts_id, t2.ts_id) AS ts_id,
    t1.*
    EXCEPT (supplier_id, supplier_name, sk_supplier, sk_region, ts_id, rn),
    t2.*
    EXCEPT (supplier_id, supplier_name, sk_supplier, sk_region, ts_id, rn)
  FROM (
    SELECT
      *
    FROM joined_prep0
    WHERE
      rn = 1
  ) AS t1
  FULL JOIN (
    SELECT
      supplier_id,
      sk_supplier,
      sk_region,
      agreement_number,
      CAST(contract_timestamp AS TEXT) AS ts_id,
      contract_timestamp
    FROM supplier_join_contract
    WHERE
      NOT contract_timestamp IS NULL
  ) AS t2
    ON t1.supplier_id = t2.supplier_id
    AND t1.supplier_name = t2.supplier_name
    AND t1.sk_supplier = t2.sk_supplier
    AND t1.sk_region = t2.sk_region
    AND t1.ts_id = t2.ts_id
), joined_table_prep2 AS (
  SELECT
    *
    EXCEPT (expiration_date, pengalamansejaktahun, pkddenganbfitahun, dob_showroom_owner, created_timestamp),
    FIRST_VALUE(expiration_date) IGNORE NULLS OVER (
      PARTITION BY supplier_id
      ORDER BY ts_id
      ROWS BETWEEN CURRENT ROW AND UNBOUNDED FOLLOWING
    ) AS expiration_date,
    LAST_VALUE(created_timestamp) IGNORE NULLS OVER (
      PARTITION BY supplier_id
      ORDER BY ts_id
      ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW
    ) AS created_timestamp
  FROM joined_table_prep1
), joined_feature_table2 AS (
  SELECT
    *
  FROM joined_table_prep2
), supplier_contract_prep3 AS (
  SELECT
    *
  FROM joined_feature_table2
), supplier_contract_prep4 AS (
  SELECT
    *,
    TIME_TO_STR(TRY_CAST(created_timestamp AS DATETIME), '%Y%m%d') AS tmp_id1,
    TIME_TO_STR(TRY_CAST(contract_timestamp AS DATETIME), '%Y%m%d') AS tmp_id2
  FROM supplier_contract_prep3
), final_preparation AS (
  SELECT
    *,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
      PARTITION BY supplier_id, sk_supplier, sk_region, tmp_id1
      ORDER BY created_timestamp DESC, expiration_date DESC
    ) AS rn_s2,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
      PARTITION BY supplier_id, agreement_number, tmp_id2
      ORDER BY contract_timestamp DESC
    ) AS rn_c2,
    TRY_CAST(contract_timestamp AS TIMESTAMP) AS event_timestamp
  FROM supplier_contract_prep4
), business_data_frequencies AS (
  SELECT
    supplier_id,
    tmp_id1 AS ts_id,
    event_timestamp
  FROM final_preparation
  WHERE
    rn_s2 = 1
), ranked_business_data AS (
  SELECT
    supplier_id,
    ts_id,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY supplier_id, ts_id ORDER BY event_timestamp DESC) AS rn
  FROM business_data_frequencies
), mailing_frequencies AS (
  SELECT
    supplier_id,
    tmp_id2 AS ts_id,
    event_timestamp
  FROM final_preparation
  WHERE
    rn_c2 = 1
), ranked_mailing AS (
  SELECT
    supplier_id,
    ts_id,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY supplier_id, ts_id ORDER BY event_timestamp DESC) AS rn
  FROM mailing_frequencies
), mailing_product AS (
  SELECT
    supplier_id,
    tmp_id2 AS ts_id,
    event_timestamp
  FROM final_preparation
  WHERE
    rn_c2 = 1
), ranked_product AS (
  SELECT
    supplier_id,
    ts_id,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY supplier_id, ts_id ORDER BY event_timestamp DESC) AS rn
  FROM mailing_product
), aggregate_supplier_prep1 AS (
  SELECT
    supplier_id,
    tmp_id1 AS ts_id,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY supplier_id, tmp_id1 ORDER BY created_timestamp DESC) AS rn,
    MAX(created_timestamp) OVER (PARTITION BY supplier_id, tmp_id1) AS event_timestamp
  FROM final_preparation
  WHERE
    rn_s2 = 1
), aggregate_view_s AS (
  SELECT
    *
    EXCEPT (rn)
  FROM aggregate_supplier_prep1
  WHERE
    rn = 1
), aggregate_contract_prep1 AS (
  SELECT
    supplier_id,
    tmp_id2 AS ts_id,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY supplier_id, tmp_id2 ORDER BY event_timestamp DESC) AS rn
  FROM final_preparation
  WHERE
    rn_c2 = 1 AND NOT tmp_id2 IS NULL
), aggregate_view_c AS (
  SELECT
    *
    EXCEPT (rn)
  FROM aggregate_contract_prep1
  WHERE
    rn = 1
), feature_view_tab0 AS (
  SELECT
    COALESCE(tab_s.supplier_id, tab_c.supplier_id) AS supplier_id,
    COALESCE(tab_s.ts_id, tab_c.ts_id) AS ts_id,
    tab_s.*
    EXCEPT (supplier_id, ts_id, event_timestamp),
    tab_c.*
    EXCEPT (supplier_id, ts_id, event_timestamp),
    GREATEST(tab_s.event_timestamp, tab_c.event_timestamp) AS event_timestamp
  FROM aggregate_view_s AS tab_s
  FULL JOIN aggregate_view_c AS tab_c
    ON tab_s.supplier_id = tab_c.supplier_id AND tab_s.ts_id = tab_c.ts_id
), feature_view AS (
  SELECT
    t1.*
    EXCEPT (event_timestamp),
    t2.*
    EXCEPT (supplier_id, ts_id, rn, event_timestamp),
    t3.*
    EXCEPT (supplier_id, ts_id, rn, event_timestamp),
    GREATEST(t1.event_timestamp, t2.event_timestamp, t3.event_timestamp, t4.event_timestamp) AS event_timestamp,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY t1.supplier_id ORDER BY t1.event_timestamp DESC) AS rn
  FROM feature_view_tab0 AS t1
  LEFT JOIN ranked_business_data AS t2
    ON t1.supplier_id = t2.supplier_id AND t1.ts_id = t2.ts_id AND t2.rn = 1
  LEFT JOIN ranked_mailing AS t3
    ON t1.supplier_id = t3.supplier_id AND t1.ts_id = t3.ts_id AND t3.rn = 1
  LEFT JOIN ranked_product AS t4
    ON t1.supplier_id = t4.supplier_id AND t1.ts_id = t4.ts_id AND t4.rn = 1
), feature_view_tab2 AS (
  SELECT
    *
    EXCEPT (supplier_id, ts_id, event_timestamp, rn),
    event_timestamp
  FROM feature_view
  UNION
  SELECT
    *
    EXCEPT (supplier_id, ts_id, event_timestamp, rn),
    TRY_CAST(STR_TO_TIME('{bizdate}', 'yyyymmdd') AS TIMESTAMP) AS event_timestamp
  FROM feature_view AS t2
  WHERE
    t2.rn = 1
    AND DATEDIFF(STR_TO_TIME('{bizdate}', 'yyyymmdd'), TRY_CAST(event_timestamp AS DATETIME), DD) < 0
)
SELECT
  event_timestamp
FROM feature_view_tab2

WITH unified_customer AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT
    tb1.cdp_uid,
    NULLIF(TRIM(tb1.agreement_number), '') AS agreement_number,
    tb1.dt
  FROM wsDataInnovation.cdp_identity_resolution AS tb1
  LEFT JOIN wsDataInnovation.cdp_lead AS tb2
    ON tb1.lead_id = tb2.lead_id AND tb1.dt = tb2.dt
  LEFT JOIN wsDataInnovation.cdp_loan AS tb3
    ON TRIM(tb1.agreement_number) = TRIM(tb3.agreement_number) AND tb1.dt = tb3.dt
  LEFT JOIN wsDataInnovation.cdp_collection AS tb4
    ON TRIM(tb1.agreement_number) = TRIM(tb4.agreement_number) AND tb1.dt = tb4.dt
  WHERE
    tb1.dt = CASE WHEN '{bizdate}' < '20100101' THEN '20100101' ELSE '{bizdate}' END
    AND /* WHERE tb1.dt = '20260621' */ NOT NULLIF(TRIM(tb1.agreement_number), '') IS NULL
), window_feature1 AS (
  SELECT
    cdp_uid,
    uc.agreement_number,
    COALESCE(co.updated_timestamp, co.created_timestamp) AS event_ts /* last updated timestamp of collection record */
  FROM unified_customer AS uc
  INNER JOIN wsDataInnovation.cdp_collection AS co
    ON uc.dt = co.dt AND uc.agreement_number = TRIM(co.agreement_number)
  WHERE
    co.dt = '{bizdate}' /* '20260621' -- */
    AND NOT NULLIF(TRIM(co.agreement_number), '') IS NULL
), collection_view AS (
  SELECT
    uc.cdp_uid
  FROM unified_customer AS uc
  INNER JOIN wsDataInnovation.cdp_loan AS cl
    ON cl.dt = uc.dt AND uc.agreement_number = TRIM(cl.agreement_number)
  INNER JOIN wsDataInnovation.cdp_collection AS co

  INNER JOIN window_feature1 AS wf1
    ON wf1.agreement_number = uc.agreement_number AND wf1.cdp_uid = uc.cdp_uid
  GROUP BY

), feature_subset1 AS (
  SELECT
    *
    EXCEPT (bucket_code, default_code)
  FROM collection_view
), window_feature2 AS (

)
